input: Hire a tutor for my teenager's algebra class

gold.taskTitle: Hire an algebra tutor for your teenager
gold.taskDescription: Find and hire a qualified tutor to help the user's teenager with their algebra class.

questions.title: Which specific algebra course is your teenager taking?
questions.description: Identify the exact course, such as Algebra 1, Algebra 2, or Pre-Algebra, to match the right tutor.

questions.title: What grade and current skill level is your teenager at?
questions.description: Understand the student's academic level to find a tutor with the right experience.

questions.title: What specific struggles or topics need the most focus?
questions.description: Pinpoint the areas where the teenager is having difficulty, such as equations, graphing, or word problems.

questions.title: Do you prefer in-person sessions or online tutoring?
questions.description: Determine the format of tutoring that works best for the family's schedule and location.

questions.title: How many sessions per week are you looking for?
questions.description: Clarify the frequency and duration of tutoring sessions needed.

questions.title: What is your budget per tutoring session or per month?
questions.description: Establish a financial boundary to narrow down suitable tutoring options.

questions.title: Do you have a deadline, such as an upcoming exam or grade report?
questions.description: Identify any time pressure to prioritize how quickly a tutor needs to be found and started.
